post.description:
Weather now and the forecast for a Canadian city or a coordinate in Canada. For alerts beyond the city page use weather_alerts; for past weather use climate_daily.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Declared unit rate: $0.0001 USD per provider_credit. Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

city_id.description: ECCC city page id, province code plus number: on-143 Toronto, qc-147 Montreal, bc-74 Vancouver, ab-52 Calgary, ns-19 Halifax. Find ids with find_cities. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}-[0-9A-Za-z]+$.

lang.description:
Language of names and texts: en (English) or fr (French). Numbers are the same in both.

Provider reference: allowed values ["en", "fr"]; default "en".

lat.description:
Latitude in decimal degrees (Canada spans about 41 to 84). Give with lon.

Provider reference: minimum -90; maximum 90.

lon.description:
Longitude in decimal degrees, west negative (Canada spans about -142 to -52). Give with lat.

Provider reference: minimum -180; maximum 180.

query.description: City or place name, English or French, accents optional (Toronto, Montreal, Quebec, St. John's).

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Current conditions, the 6-to-7-day public forecast, the 24-hour hourly forecast, active warnings, regional normals and sunrise/sunset for one ECCC city forecast location (the data behind weather.gc.ca/en/location and the city pages), in English or French. Choose the location by city_id, by lat/lon (nearest of the ~840 ECCC forecast locations) or by name query (best match: exact name, prefix, contains, then region). An unknown city_id is not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `attribution` | string | Attribution the ECCC Data Servers End-use Licence requires when the data is republished. |
| `city` | object |  |
| `current` | object | Latest hourly observation; null when the page has none. |
| `distance_km` | number | Distance from lat/lon to the city location; null otherwise. |
| `forecast_issued_at` | string |  |
| `forecasts` | object[] | Forecast periods in order (day and night). |
| `hourly` | object[] | Hourly forecast; empty when include_hourly is false. |
| `hourly_issued_at` | string |  |
| `lang` | string | Language of the texts. |
| `last_updated` | string |  |
| `licence_url` | string | The ECCC Data Servers End-use Licence. |
| `matched_by` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | When this program read the source, epoch milliseconds. |
| `regional_normals` | object | Normal high and low for the date. |
| `source_url` | string | The api.weather.gc.ca request this answer was read from. |
| `sunrise` | string |  |
| `sunset` | string |  |
| `warnings` | object[] | Warnings, watches and statements in effect for the location; empty when none. |

200.description:
Daily climate observations of one ECCC climate station (climate.weather.gc.ca daily data): mean, min and max temperature, precipitation, rain, snow, snow on ground, max gust, degree days and humidity, each with its ECCC quality flag. start/end (YYYY-MM-DD) select up to 366 days; one bound alone gives 31 days from it; no bounds gives the most recent 31 days on record. An unknown climate_id is not_found; days without data in the window are an empty list.

The response contains the tool result directly.

200.description:
Canadian Climate Normals 1981-2010 of one ECCC climate station, the normals period GeoMet publishes: every element (temperatures, degree days, days above or below thresholds, rain, snow, precipitation, snow depth, sunshine, frost dates...) with its 12 monthly values, annual value and quality code. The 1991-2020 normals are not on the open API. A station without normals answers an empty element list; an unknown climate_id is not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

200.description:
Search ECCC climate stations (the station list behind climate.weather.gc.ca historical data and normals): by climate_id, by part of the station name (query), by province, near lat/lon within radius_km (sorted by distance), and only stations with 1981-2010 normals (has_normals) or hourly data (has_hourly). 200.description:
ECCC marine forecast and warnings for one marine area (weather.gc.ca/marine): regular forecast per sub-area (winds, weather and visibility, air temperature, freezing spray), the extended forecast, the wave forecast where issued, and marine warnings in effect. Choose by area_id or by lat/lon on the water (the containing area). An unknown area_id is not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

city_id.description: ECCC city page id, province code plus number: on-143 Toronto, qc-147 Montreal, bc-74 Vancouver, ab-52 Calgary, ns-19 Halifax. Find ids with find_cities. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}-[0-9A-Za-z]+$.

200.description:
Active ECCC public weather alerts (warnings, watches, advisories and statements, the data behind weather.gc.ca/warnings) for a city page (city_id), a point (lat/lon: alerts whose area contains it), a province or territory, or all of Canada when no selector is given. Alert text is returned exactly as issued, as the ECCC licence requires. Ended alerts are dropped unless include_ended. No alert in effect is an empty list; an unknown city_id is not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `alerts` | object[] | Newest publication first; one row per alert area. |
| `attribution` | string | Attribution the ECCC Data Servers End-use Licence requires when the data is republished. |
| `city` | object | The city page when city_id was given. |
